label: Configuration
title: Repository configuration
description: Map autobuild.toml settings to verification, agent roles, capacity, ticket readiness, merge policy, and editable skills.
code:
[commands]
typecheck = "bun tsc --noEmit"

[verify]
steps = ["types", "acceptance"]

[verify.types]
kind = "check"
command = "typecheck"
always = true

[verify.acceptance]
kind = "agent"
skill = "verify-acceptance" # repository-authored skill

capacity = 2

[roles.default]
runtime = "claude"

[roles.code-review]
runtime = "pi"
model = "kimi-coding/k3"

[policy]
maxReviewRounds = 6
maxVerifyAttempts = 3
sessionBudgetSeconds = 3600

[accounts.personal]
kind = "claude-subscription"
credentialEnv = "CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN"

[accounts.kimi]
kind = "kimi-code"
credentialEnv = "KIMI_CODE_KEY"
region = "overseas"

[accounts.kimi-china]
kind = "kimi-code"
credentialEnv = "KIMI_CHINA_KEY"
region = "china"

[roles.implement]
runtime = "claude"
account = "kimi"
model = "kimi-for-coding"

bun ab init
bun ab init --validate
